limitations: This is a same-target forecast-revision STATISTICAL PROXY, not certified historical Treasury public release vintages
A/A+/A++ categorization cannot be finalized without full real-time Treasury, tax schedule, Fed and gold factor evidence
252 prior decisions, not 252 independent model vintage archives; one revision per eligible decision date
No gold trade profitability or execution is tested
Statistical forecast revisions are not confirmed official historical Treasury forecast releases
Gold macro filter agreement, prior Dow trends, COMEX contract execution and full liquidity confirmation remain separate gates
Rolling Z parameters and issuance model were developed with overlapping 2025-2026 research samples: no untouched strategy holdout
Candidate price patterns cluster; do not count these as independent winning trades
Research-only level direction; NOT the V2.2 fiscal forecast REVISION Z-score
No current-day Treasury cash balance is used to generate the decision forecast
Conservative decision availability is 23:59:59 UTC; real historical release time is unverified
Same historical window was used during model iteration; no untouched out-of-sample strategy result
Gold price patterns are non-independent and may represent repeats during one trend
Does NOT imply market profit or combine with full factor and risk rules

30bn.forecast_source: As-of Treasury Bills announcement gross awards, historical missing-issue seasonal estimate, known maturity, lagged nondebt residual, prior-year tax window; not full V2.2 cash forecast
30bn.observation_rule: Forecast fixed at PREVIOUS weekday 23:59:59Z; gold price observation starts next weekday 00:00Z; target T after 1/3/5 additional weekdays
limitations: Each T-k observation freezes its MODEL ESTIMATE from T-(k+1); no future gold/realized TGA values select event
T-5 requires a D+6 projection, an exploratory extension not previously validated for fiscal MAE
A model forecast is NOT independently measured market expectations or consensus; actual Treasury publication vintage unverified
2025 and 2026 were used to develop calendar model and are not untouched out-of-sample years
Dollar macro credit, Fed, gold ETF/CFTC, full Dow higher timeframe trend and four-hour execution are NOT jointly validated
Hypothesized gold direction assumes drain bad for gold, but RRP buffers and fiscal credit risk can reverse the sign
Same-date naive always-long gold is an observational direction baseline, NOT a leveraged position, costed trade or independent out-of-sample
Event windows overlap, results are price moves NOT independent risk-managed trade PnL
Yahoo GC=F continuous hourly proxy and midnight UTC event boundary do not verify actual COMEX settlements
